flag_note: Yack's YF-1 and YF-2 should be retained as distinct early Japanese fuzz models. Collector documentation places YF-2 in the 1967-1969 period, but the precise introduction date and relationship of YF-1 to YF-2 remain provisional.

YF-2 and DA-1 are separate Yack fuzz models. Collector research suggests DA-1 followed YF-1 and is conceptually related to Ace Tone FM-1-era designs, but no evidence supports treating DA-1 as a reissue of YF-2.
